purpose: prospective multi-species public-data validation of ODSP state-resolved altitude prediction across independent held-out individuals

source.dataset_name: BOP_RODENT - Rodent specialized birds of prey (Circus, Asio, Buteo) in Flanders (Belgium)
source.reason_for_fixed_version: immutable checksums and tractable 94 MB GPS archive; later versions are not substituted after outcome access

observation_filter.temporal_thinning: within each individual retain the earliest admissible event in each absolute UTC 60-minute bin

prediction_target.semantic_limit: absolute altitude state, not height above ground level

covariates.species_encoding: one-hot columns for admitted species in lexicographic species-name order, derived within the admitted dataset before group folds
covariates.logit_standardization: continuous features centered/scaled using training-fold moments; species indicators not standardized

independence_and_admission.fold_assignment: within each admitted species, sort eligible individual IDs by sha256(individual_id), then assign round-robin to folds 0..4
independence_and_admission.scoring_unit: each held-out individual scored separately even when multiple individuals share a fold
independence_and_admission.training_weighting: each admitted species contributes equal total weight; within species each training individual contributes equal total weight

terminal_rule_primary_rf.unavailable: admission minimums fail or any held-out individual reaches an altitude state absent from its training fold
terminal_rule_primary_rf.generalizing: every scored held-out individual across all admitted species has mean_log_score_gain > 0
terminal_rule_primary_rf.non_generalizing: every scored held-out individual has mean_log_score_gain <= 0
terminal_rule_primary_rf.species_level_categories: reported separately using the same sign rule but cannot override the all-individual terminal category

claim_ceiling.positive_result_supports: species-aware environmental/context models predict absolute altitude-state distributions that transfer across held-out individual raptors better than training marginal altitude distributions
does_not_support: height above ground without terrain correction
causal effects of weather, time, geography or species identity
universal transfer to bird species outside the admitted public dataset
